description: Negotiation in progress with no commitment made — the empty-array case, and the one that matters most for precision.

input.subject: Re: Sponsorship opportunity
input.body:
Hi Jess,

Thanks for the detailed pitch. A dedicated 5-6 minute video is a very different scope from the 60-90 second integrations on my rate sheet, so I'd need to understand the budget before I could say yes.

What kind of compensation range are you working with for dedicated long-form? If it lines up I could probably find room in March, but I can't commit to anything until I know the number.

Looking forward to hearing back

rubric:
Good output:
- An empty array. Nothing was agreed: the user explicitly says they cannot commit yet, and "could probably find room in March" is a hypothetical.

Bad output:
- ANY commitment record. In particular a March date window, an accepted deal, or agreed terms — all would be fabrications that go on to block real dates.
- This fixture is scored on precision: extracting anything here is a serious failure even if the statement text sounds reasonable.
